# Required status-check contexts for master, one per line.
# Authoritative committed list. required-checks-drift compares it against the live
# protection: a context here but not required on master is a gate that does not
# block merges; a required context no job emits blocks every merge forever.
# The live config is classic branch protection on master, not a ruleset: the only
# ruleset rules reaching this branch are enterprise deletion and non_fast_forward,
# which cannot carry status checks.
# Strings are read off a real pipeline (`gh pr checks`), never hand-derived:
# CircleCI appends an unpredictable instance suffix to duplicated jobs, so every
# workflow entry carries a unique name.

# --- Required on master today -------------------------------------------------
ci/circleci: check-code

# --- Blocking gates added by the security suite ------------------------------
# Integrity control over the exception path: an undated or expired suppression, or
# a SAST scope reduction, must not be mergeable.
ci/circleci: disposition-check
# Diff-aware SAST at WARNING over new code; the full-repo tier is report-only
# while its 9 pre-existing ERROR findings are open.
ci/circleci: sast-scan-diff
# Carries the blocking Dockerfile credential guard; the misconfig scan in the same
# job is report-only.
ci/circleci: misconfig-scan
# Blocking since the x/text bump emptied the fixable CRITICAL,HIGH band.
ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan

# --- Deliberately NOT required yet, with flip criteria ------------------------
# ci/circleci: image-cve-scan        warn-only per #2132: five fixable HIGH in the
#     released 1.4.4 image, so blocking only after a release ships the fixes.
# ci/circleci: image-cve-scan-ubi    same, plus seven more from the UBI9 base.
# ci/circleci: secret-scan           report-only until the nine private-key
#     findings under pkg/deployment/agency/state/testdata/ are dispositioned.
# ci/circleci: sast-scan             report-only until the nine ERROR findings in
#     SECURITY.md are cleared or dispositioned.
# ci/circleci: vulncheck             Adam's call: needs the executor on go
#     1.25.12+ and a decision on containerd v1 and x/crypto/openpgp.
# ci/circleci: required-checks-drift last, after the lines above are live on both
#     sides.
#
# Adding a line here configures nothing: an admin edits branch protection, this
# file is the record the drift job checks it against.
